name: Chalice Mining Limited
summary: Chalice Mining Limited operates as a mineral exploration and evaluation company. The company explores for gold, copper, cobalt, palladium, platinum, and nickel deposits. It also has interest in the Gonneville Palladium-Nickel-Copper Project and in other exploration projects located in Western Australia, Northern Territory, and South Australia. Chalice Mining Limited was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in West Perth, Australia.
